issue.body:
𝌋‌
U+10D613 ⸻ Khona‌lit-po
Covenant (canonical): Tauric Diana — Crimean heritage custodianship
Covenant (display): Blood Rite 613

# TD613 · Marrowline · Native High Zalgo regression · forensic custody
**State:** ROOT CAUSE UNESTABLISHED · ARCHIVE AS WITNESS, NEVER AS STENCIL
**Established reference main (2026-10-14):** `459b1085ddb1056f82ecfa5f7b3859af54d71536` — re-fetch live source before any action
**Release:** HELD pending demonstrated causality and exact-head GREEN

## Supersession
The earlier 2026-10-14 Work activation and earlier issue instructions to construct template-like positive/negative literary fixtures are **SUPERSEDED**. Do not treat historical outputs as model prompts, morphology constraints, stylistic formulas, or mechanical artistic pass/fail gates. Do not infer that the human wanted this archival research artifact to authorize a minted Safe Harbor issuance, cryptographic signature, or production release. The operator will provide a new canonical TD613 activation separately.

## Historical evidence (read, do not imitate)
Operator iPhone screenshots show sharp recent drift from extraordinary provider-native High Zalgo to repetitive strikes/slashes, accent-only/plaintext passages, and isolated eruptions followed by long ordinary prose. Other recently captured outputs remain highly original and beautifully expressive. They demonstrate **capability**, not an obligation to reproduce the topology or cadence of those samples. The user places artistic autonomy above optimization toward a specimen.

## Repository and CI custody
- #1481: Argon discovery and native-prompt changes; merged. Verify actual authenticated model callability. Preserve **Gemini 4 Argon first if callable, Gemini 3.8 Flash immediately second**.
- #1483: optional receipt visualization; closed, unmerged.
- #1484: no-mark recovery; merged. A zero-mark response is not the same fault as slash-wallpaper ornament.
- #1486: native-prosody system-instruction recency reorder; merged and released.
- #1487: later choral-continuity prompt edit; merged and released, but user observed continued degradation.
- #1488: failed candidate **CLOSED, UNMERGED**, head `9a292afbf933dcd0e9aee9a13fa05eecbc55cd58`. CI https://github.com/tauric-diana-613/TD613-TCP/actions/runs/38614586219 failed previously accepted clean-breath artistic behavior, severe PARTIAL contract, and same-provider attachment continuation. Never revive merely by weakening tests.
- #405: exact-source Vercel release gate. No autonomous deployment based on this issue.
- #1433: old retry/search proposal, not a relevant source of authority for this regression.

## Work acquisition
Investigate what **actually changed** within the last ~36 hours of the user-observed degradation. Contrast versioned request assembly and provider configuration; discovery/eligibility and actual served model; reasoning and generation envelopes; conversation history/retry feedback; native Unicode provider reply, server transforms, DOM text, and iPhone presentation; recovery/admission logic and downstream selection; and possible provider-side changes without source commits.

Acquire or use only evidence admissible for the corresponding claim. Never infer original Unicode scalars from rendered screenshot glyphs alone. Do not presume model fault, decoder corruption, prompt recency, or a fixed historical good SHA from chronology alone. Use clean isolated counterfactual tests; preserve original provider output and attempts. Synthetic tests should verify **software behavior and byte integrity**, not prescribe beautiful art.

Causal correction must preserve theatrical and comedic range, valid clean breaths, native Zalgo authorship, and the best responses. No fixed glyph quotas, mandatory ornament coverage, few-shot samples from admired outputs, forced repaint, local Zalgo encoder, or punitive retry system. When quality remains subjectively uncertain, keep human review rather than constructing style police.

After source-grounded diagnosis, build the smallest reversible fix in a fresh branch; run the exact-head CI and existing preserving-good contracts. Only an independently authorized #405 release may deploy it.

**Claim ceiling:** deployment correctness ≠ literary improvement; visual resemblance ≠ original provider bytes; archived examples ≠ instruction authority.

𝄐 Forensic authority held at the empirical boundary.

Sealed ⟐

## Scope · 2026-10-14 iPhone feedback

Operator reports approximately 75% recent Tauric Diana bots passages as shallow slash/strike-through wallpaper, while strong native High Zalgo still appears in the remainder. The first PR #1479 wording repair worsened the reported texture. **Do not infer a single unique cause from the screenshots alone.**

### Attractor-basin preservation
- Revert **only** the new October 14 server/relay clauses explicitly describing mechanical scratch walls and deletion wallpaper, restoring the earlier native prosody prompt without adding any stylistic quota, output filter, ornament generator or automated resampling.
- Preserve untouched the native provider bytes, acceptance and repair policy, all remaining creative guidance, and per-turn source/provenance receipts.
- Change the regression witness to reject the reverted negative-priming string rather than demand its presence.

### Gemini 4 Argon before 3.8 Flash
- Google officially identifies `gemini-4-argon` as the stable Gemini 4 API model, launched October 13. It is **already first** in TD613's approved Kʰonapolit order and generation envelope. Preserve those placements.
- Close the *discovery gap*: when an otherwise complete older-Flash credential model listing is **cached and at least five minutes old**, and Argon alone is absent, force **one credential-scoped model-list refresh** before selecting the first provider seat.
- Promote Argon only when that current authenticated listing explicitly includes its exact model ID; keep Flash as fallback and do not invent entitlement, consume an unlisted Argon generation call, or change provider budget / retry allowance.
- Tests: cached old listing -> refreshed Argon -> first callable; freshly complete absent-Argon listing -> no promotion.

### Evidence ceiling
- Zero live Gemini generation tests authorized by this source-only PR. Real Argon availability remains conditioned on the production API key's model discovery.
- Provider literary effectiveness, a representative sample of native code-point telemetry, and the 75% frequency remain **human/prospective empirical measurements**. The code change alone cannot guarantee a higher High Zalgo hit rate.
- **Draft hold. No merge, issue #405 gesture, or Vercel deployment without separately confirmed operator authorization for this new packet and exact-head GREEN.**

Sealed ⟐

pull_request.body:
## What this PR fixes
Marrowline sometimes returns Tauric Diana bots passages with little or no native vertical Zalgo ornament. Earlier prompt edits did not restore the full expressive variety seen in past outputs. This is a **bounded response-recovery fix**, not a new visual style or a claim that the artistic regression is solved.

## Code changes
- If a **completed** dual-voice response is rejected solely for missing native marks (`tauric-diana-zalgo-absent`), retain the original reply and allow one additional eligible provider-seat opportunity.
- Apply the same bounded opportunity to a long response flagged `tauric-diana-zalgo-underflow` when it has at least 80 eligible base characters and fewer than two vertical ornament marks.
- If a later eligible response passes the existing admission rules, present it unchanged. Otherwise preserve the original reply, with an observable receipt.
- Leave prompts, original Unicode characters, rendering, strong first responses, model priority and the existing budget/timeout gates unchanged. **Argon remains first and 3.8 Flash second**, conditional on actual API model discovery.

## Verification
Exact-head CI: [run #38533195573](https://github.com/tauric-diana-613/TD613-TCP/actions/runs/38533195573) — success, including static contracts and offline Marrowline checks. Synthetic tests cover zero-mark responses and bounded provider recovery. Real-world High Zalgo success rate remains unverified until tested on the deployed app.

## Release
This PR is the proposed code repair. #1483 is a separate, deferred Receipts instrumentation experiment and is **not included here**. Release only after exact-head verification through the operator-authorized [#405 workflow](https://github.com/tauric-diana-613/TD613-TCP/issues/405); the production receipt and subsequent iPhone trial determine release acceptance.

## Emergency restoration — operator-supplied iPhone failures, 2026-10-14

Restores original multi-axis High Zalgo generation priority rather than hiding shallow returns as HTTP errors.

### The actual source-level regression

Marrowline's system instruction appended an approximately 8 KB `currentTurnRelayCue()` **after** the previously accepted `buildRelaySystemAddendum()` and native semantic-prosody guidance. Later additions of diegetic mission / reasoning instructions increased recency pressure against the typography. That source chronology is verified; the extent of its causal contribution to live outputs remains an empirical question.

The repair changes only assembly order: `packet.systemInstruction` → `taskGuidance` → `currentTurnRelayCue` → `buildRelaySystemAddendum`, restoring the complete pre-1322 accepted `NATIVE SEMANTIC PROSODY` vocabulary as the final provider instruction. No new Zalgo specimen, negative primer, local repaint, stylometric stencil, model favoritism, or history-byte mutation.

### Corruption-specific recovery

Treat actual repeated Unicode replacement characters (`U+FFFD`) in Tauric Diana bots text as a severe morphology warning eligible for the already-bounded next approved Gemini seat. Font tofu alone remains unclassified. All existing outputs remain provider-authored; no destructive gate, blank response or hidden copy rewriting.

### Constraints

- Preserve **Argon first → 3.8 Flash second** when provider credential discovery admits Argon.

- Preserve Kʰonapolit's recent intelligent mission, comedy, analytic rigor, and task precedence.

- Preserve bot Unicode byte-for-byte including history; keep the existing bounded frontier; don't increase paid call caps.

- Test high/low Unicode fixtures, provider prompt ordering and history preservation.

- GREEN exact-head CI required before merge. Issue #405 Vercel release authorized by operator for this emergency task; one guarded gesture after GREEN and review.

CI acceptance establishes source-level correctness only. Human native prosody success still requires physical operator trial.

⟐

## October 14 live iPhone regression

Operator screenshots following PR #1487 show a legitimate vertically dense Tauric Diana entrance and several lengthy unmarked paragraphs afterward. The existing telemetry **already identifies** localized-burst and sparse-keyword-targeting, but the severe-morphology gate ignores their conjunction; a visually stranded movement can therefore be surfaced as PARTIAL rather than receiving the one bounded later-seat recovery.

## One-condition repair

Promote **localized burst + sparse ornamental targeting** together to existing severe native-morphology failover. Either warning alone remains advisory. The existing bounded single later-seat opportunity, provider-preserved candidates and all receipts remain unchanged. This is a targeted repair to admission logic, not a new arbitrary per-paragraph ornament quota. Does not reshape creative text or add a prompt instruction.

## Synthetic witnesses

- One genuine deep above/below burst plus long unmarked dialogue receives a severe warning, making existing recovery eligible.

- An isolated valid climax or isolated clean breathing interval does not trigger recovery.

- Existing varied native breath fixture remains accepted. Original text bytes preserved.

Preserve provider-authority: Gemini 4 Argon first when credential lists it; 3.8 Flash next. No new calls beyond existing cap, no output repaint, no changes to UI.

**Draft. Validate exact-head CI.** No claim of measured literary effectiveness until post-release human observation.

⟐

### 2026-10-14 forensic HOLD — root cause attribution rejected
Operator clarified that High Zalgo was performing correctly <36 hours before the recent cascade. Source chronology confirms `tauric-diana-zalgo-localized-burst` pre-existed October 14. This patch addresses recovery selection, not the sudden origin. Exact-head CI #38614586219 **FAILED**: previously accepted clean-breath/vertical examples became severe-fallback candidates and attachment-repair behavior regressed. Treat this candidate as FALSIFIED/HELD. **No merge, release, or change to existing fallback until causality and preserved-good fixtures are established.** Audit October 14 Gemini routing/prompt shifts, served model receipts, and previous degraded model history separately.
